name: Water Rings and Heat Marks on Hardwood
title-tag: Water Rings & Heat Marks on Hardwood: How to Fix Them
meta-description: White rings come out; dark rings mean sanding. A refinishing contractor explains how to read water and heat marks on hardwood, which remedies work, and costs.
post-summary: January 25, 2027 · A white ring means moisture trapped in the finish — usually fixable with patience, gentle heat, or a one-day recoat. A dark ring means water reached the wood, and that spot needs sanding. How to read the marks, the home remedies ranked honestly, and what each fix costs.
